description: Re-anchored for the already_done disposition + strong-reason guard spec change (v0.13.0): spec.md additively documents the already_done on-issue disposition (ALREADY_DONE_MARKER distinct from REJECT_MARKER, gh_issue_already_done_sink mirroring the reject sink, reusing REJECTED_LABEL, never closing, idempotent on the marker) and the pure is_strong_reason guard (>=40 chars stripped + no reflexive-deferral boilerplate). This is legitimate new behaviour (mirrors the reject-disposition precedent), not re-bloat. This baseline records the post-v0.13.0 doc line counts plus a one-line margin, so the housekeep gate continues as a re-bloat regression guard (current docs must stay STRICTLY smaller than this) while the load-bearing-token + cleanup gates remain intact.
